captions.detailed: This 3D model is a corner bracket designed to hold a picture frame sandwich against a wall. It has a triangular L-shape with rounded outer edges and a raised perimeter lip forming a recessed pocket to secure the picture and backing. The inner corner features a small circular hole for threading a hanging cord, and one of the flat outer vertical faces is embossed with a small stylized monogram.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric corner bracket for hanging picture frames in OpenSCAD. The bracket should feature a rounded outer L-profile, a recessed pocket with adjustable minimum and maximum sandwich depth, a cord hole at the inner corner, and an embossed monogram on one of the outer walls.
captions.factory: The script starts with a base block created using the MCAD/boxes roundedBox module. A difference operation cuts out the inner recessed pocket using a combination of a central cube and angled cubes rotated at 45 degrees to match the corner profile. The model is sliced diagonally using a rotated cube to form the L-shape, followed by subtracting a cylinder for the cord hole and subtracting a custom extruded monogram on the outer wall.
